stories.title: Venezuela debates sweeping amnesty for political prisoners
stories.summary: After the fall of Nicolás Maduro, the Venezuelan regime promise amnesty and reconciliation — but for hundreds still jailed and thousands facing charges, justice remains uncertain.

stories.title: Ilia Malinin, U.S. figure skater favored for gold, finishes 8th
stories.summary: Malinin, undefeated since 2023, stumbled and fell multiple times, landing far off the podium. Mikhail Shaidorov of Kazakhstan won gold in an upset that shocked even himself.

stories.title: Big-time hockey is back at the Olympics
stories.summary: A look at the headliners in hockey at the Winter Olympics.

stories.title: The rising cost of online betting addiction among young people
stories.summary: In an era when you can bet on almost any sporting event on your phone, it is no surprise that gambling addiction is on the rise. Young men are particularly likely to get in too deep. WBUR's Patrick Madden reports from Massachusetts.

stories.title: What monogamy in the animal world tells us about ourselves
stories.summary: As Valentine's Day approaches, we take a look at monogamy and its alternatives among animals — including humans.

stories.title: Bangladesh's first fair vote in years comes with a daunting to-do list
stories.summary: A landmark election in Bangladesh ended years of disputed polls, and now the winners face pressure to tackle corruption and a battered economy.
